item.description:
Location: Mumbai
Description:

A shore-based position for a Marine Superintendent is available for tankers operating worldwide. The role involves providing shore support, overseeing daily operations with a focus on navigation, cargo, health, safety, and environmental aspects. Responsibilities include ensuring compliance with SMS, international regulations, and conducting audits. Key requirements include a Master Mariner (FG) qualification with sailing experience on product/chemical tankers, and 1-3 years of experience as a Marine Superintendent. Strong knowledge of maritime codes and excellent leadership skills are essential.



Apply to this job
